title: Panel: software terms, month by month
population: A fixed panel of 78 business tools (Tools whose pricing page had readable amounts in our Price Watch captures of August, September and October 2026. Fixed at creation; tools are never added later.)
selection: Tools whose pricing page had readable amounts in our Price Watch captures of August, September and October 2026. Fixed at creation; tools are never added later.

headline.text: panel tools with a confirmed price change in the last reviewed round (2026-09 to 2026-10)

limitations: The panel is the tools whose pricing pages we can read automatically, not a random sample.
A changed set of amounts is only a price change after a person has read both captures; until then it is 'awaiting review'.
Terms come from our dossiers and carry the dossier's reading date, which can be older than the newest capture.
AI access and export options are not recorded in a structured way yet.
next_full_recheck: monthly: capture on the 1st-2nd, review of the differences, then a new edition

corrections.what: The September to October 2026 page pairs were reviewed by hand on 7 October 2026. The 24 differences this edition first showed as 'awaiting review' are now 2 confirmed changes (Intelis, decrease; Runpod, increase) and 22 'reviewed: no price change' (capture differences, currency or storefront switches, promotions with the regular price unchanged, and amounts only added or only removed). No capture or dossier figure changed.
Dossier reading dates updated for Gorgias (2026-09-08 to 2026-10-07) and Zendesk (2026-09-05 to 2026-10-07) after both dossiers were re-read on 7 October 2026; no amounts, terms or counts changed.
